thread:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY deploy scheduled: cfg-2026-03-fanout-throttle v2 -> staging. rolling canary 8% for 15m. params: routing weight, per-conn timeout, tinybatch window, shard-fanout cap. commit `a1b2c3f`. link: https://git.redwood/cfg/commit/a1b2c3f

maria: quick summary of delta?

ashwin: small: routing policy adds per-route weight cap (0.25), default per-req timeout lowered 1200ms -> 900ms, batching window 6ms -> 4ms, fanout cap per model shard 6 -> 4. no model artifacts, no schema changes.

lucy: why lower timeout? are we expecting backend cold spikes?

ashwin: perf data from last week showed tail P95 token latency up from 850ms to ~1.1s on heavy routes. shorter timeout reduces queueing and avoids retry storms; combined with smaller batch window should reduce P99.

maria: can we pin critical customers to old routing during canary?

ashwin: yes. will pin accounts matching tag `enterprise-critical` to legacy routing policy for the canary window. rollout script includes `--pin=tag:enterprise-critical`

sam_sre: monitoring checklist added to rollout notes: latency HPA, error rate, success rate per-route, queue depth. alerts: 5% failure increase or P99 > 2s => abort. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/config-deploys

oncall_rot: @sam_sre i'll be on watch for the 30m after canary. i have alert dashboard open.

maria: rollback plan spelled out?

ashwin: rollback = revert config snapshot + reapply previous pin map. steps in notes. quick commands:

```
# abort canary
redwoodctl deploy config rollback --snapshot cfg-2026-03-12-prev
# verify
redwoodctl status rollout --id cfg-2026-03-fanout-throttle
```

lucy: any expected client impact during rollback? ideally none, but routing switch may cause brief reconnections. add a 2m drain after rollback to avoid inflight truncation.

maria: timeline?

deploy-bot: START: 1759954600 (in 50s) -> canary 8% for 15m -> evaluate -> staged ramp 8->40 over 30m if healthy -> full 100 in controlled steps.

ashwin: preflight checks: config lint pass, staging smoke ok, infra capacity verified.

sam_sre: also watch KV cache pressure; smaller batch window ups KV churn. alert if miss rate increases > 10%.

oncall_rot: got it. i'll mute non-critical noise and post updates here.

maria: tagging release notes: "Config-only: routing weight cap, reduced per-request timeout, smaller batching window, lowered shard fanout cap. Improves latency tail under load; monitor for cache churn and failed tails."

lucy: :thumbsup: Also add note for ops to expect short reconnects during full rollout/rollback.

ashwin: post-canary checklist: capture perf traces, export sample requests (sanitized), run eval set to verify output quality. if any quality regression -> rollback immediately.

oncall_rot: starting watch window now. posting heartbeat at +5m +10m +15m.

maria: thanks team. ping if anything funky.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automated canary metric gate configured: latency_p99 < 1.5s AND error_rate_delta < 3% over baseline to continue. abort trigger: error_rate +5% OR p99 > 2s for 5m.

sam_sre: acknowledged. I'll escalate if gate trips.

oncall_rot: 5m heartbeat: canary healthy, no alert. cpu and queue depth stable.

maria: thanks — keeping this thread for rollback decision and timestamps.
